caption: The drawing depicts an oval dish or platter with an ornate border decorated with floral motifs and birds. The inner scene shows a rural landscape with a river in the foreground and a bridge crossing over it. Several figures are visible near the river bank, including a horse-drawn covered wagon moving along a path, and another group appears to be walking or standing near the water. There are trees surrounding the scene, with one prominent tree leaning over the river. In the background, there are buildings, one of which is adjacent to the bridge, and another structure with columns is visible to the right. The sky is filled with clouds, and the overall color scheme of the drawing is monochromatic, rendered in grayscale. The entire composition is contained within the boundaries of the plate, with the detailed border framing the central pastoral scene.
title: Platter - "Bridge over Skuykill"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
